home.how_title: From profile to offer, one clear path
home.how_sub: Six steps. You do three of them; Fursad does the rest.
home.step_1_d: Paste your CV and the AI parses it into a structured profile — skills, education and experience filled in for you.
home.step_2_d: The matching engine weighs skills at 45%, location 20%, salary 15%, education 10% and experience 10%.
home.step_3_d: Roles arrive sorted by fit, with a breakdown showing which part of your profile earned the score.
home.step_4_d: Your match score and an AI summary of your suitability travel with the application to the employer.
home.step_5_d: Message the hiring team directly, and get AI interview preparation tailored to the role.
home.step_6_d: Track every stage — reviewed, shortlisted, interview, offer — without ever chasing an email.

home.faq_1_q: Does it cost anything to look for a job?
home.faq_1_a: No. Creating a profile, browsing every vacancy and applying is completely free for job seekers, and always will be.
home.faq_2_q: How is my match score calculated?
home.faq_2_a: Five weighted factors: how many required skills you have (45%), whether you are in the right city or country (20%), whether your salary expectation overlaps the range (15%), your education level (10%) and your experience level (10%). The score is calculated when you apply and never changes afterwards.
home.faq_3_q: Do I need a CV to sign up?
home.faq_3_a: It helps but it is not required. You can paste the text of an existing CV and have it parsed automatically, or fill in your profile by hand.
home.faq_4_q: How do I know a job posting is genuine?
home.faq_4_a: Every listing is checked automatically for fraud and quality signals before it goes live. Anything that scores poorly or raises a flag is held back for a human administrator to approve or reject.
home.hero_trust: Free for job seekers · Somali and English · Every vacancy reviewed before it appears
home.trusted_sub: Every employer here has at least one open vacancy that has passed review, and a company profile you can read before you decide to apply.
home.why_sub: Four things that change what actually happens when you apply. Each one is a rule enforced in the product, not a promise on a page.
home.why_1_m: Skills carry 45% of every score — the heaviest single factor
home.why_2_m: Salary overlap is worth 15% of the match
home.why_3_m: Nothing reaches the public site until a person approves it
home.why_4_m: Switch language on any page, at any time
